subject: B1 V3 dead components in 60-code universe under default config
caveat: DEAD here means 'never materially affects candidate space under default B1V3Params on the 60-code universe used for the Phase 9-14B audits'. These components may activate under different parameter configs or different universes. Future agents should re-verify before deleting.

components.evidence: Phase 12A Class III, Phase 12C avg ΔJac +0.002, Phase 14B remove-one zero impact in all 3 windows.
components.reason: 60-code universe: no stock has 'doubled in 60d' triggered AND every code already has market_cap >= 4B. Both predicates never fire.

components.evidence: Phase 12C avg ΔJac -0.001 (restoring tight bowl actually INCREASES candidates in A/B). Phase 14B avg single ΔPF +0.019.
components.reason: Wave_qualified + white > yellow + position checks already enforce a tighter envelope than bowl_near_pct=3.5. Bowl tolerance is dominated.

components.evidence: Setting prefilter_j_max=BIG individually has zero effect because j_max=30 still fires at B1 stage.
components.reason: Redundant with B1 J upper bound under defaults.

components.evidence: Phase 12A Class III, Phase 14B single-removal Jaccard 1.000.
components.reason: Wave_qualified + bowl + J<30 stack already excludes K>=D candidates. K<D coarse gate is shadowed.
components.qualifying_note: NOT dead in joint removal: A_J_range + B_KltD removal causes int_PF -0.94 below additive. This component activates conditionally when A_J_range is also disabled.

components.evidence: Phase 14B remove-one zero impact in all 3 windows.
components.reason: vol_shrink_mode='v1' ignores vol_ratio_ma5_max entirely. The parameter exists in B1V3Params but has no consumer at default mode.
components.qualifying_note: Active under vol_shrink_mode in {v2, both, either}. Dead is conditional on mode = v1.

components.evidence: Phase 14B remove-one effect very small (avg Δtr +1.3, ΔPF -0.015).
components.reason: At default 0.9 the volume-shrink-vs-wave-peak gate is dominated by C_wave_qualified and other vol gates. Effectively redundant at this threshold.
components.qualifying_note: Tightening below 0.5 would change this status (Phase 9 G3 in Phase 13 used tighter contraction successfully). Dead is conditional on threshold.

components.evidence: Phase 14A feature inventory: 5 columns marked UNUSED.
components.reason: Data is loaded into the indicator parquet but no consumer reads them in extract_signals_single / _compute_features / scoring / ranking / exits.

missing_runtime_dimensions.notes: No index reference, no rolling market state.

summary.key_finding: B1 V3 carries non-trivial unused capacity in its parquet schema and ranking config. The 'dead under defaults' is not necessarily dead under other configurations.
